root_cause: LinkedIn execution on Composio v3.1 was still using the legacy natural-language text payload without user_id.
The publisher treated an exact-readback failure after a successful LinkedIn create as a generic publication failure.
That can hide a real provider side effect and tempt a later retry to create a duplicate.
fix: Use connected_account_id + user_id + version=latest + structured arguments for LinkedIn tool execution.
Once CREATE returns a real LinkedIn post URN, set provider_create_success=true and republish_forbidden=true.
If post-create readback is unavailable or forbidden, keep the exact claim DISPATCHED/verification_pending instead of FAILED or retryable.
prevention: Regression tests must reject legacy text execution for LinkedIn v3.1.
A provider-created post URN is an irreversible side-effect marker for the daily channel claim.
Never issue a replacement LinkedIn post for the same run_date/channel when provider_create_success is true.
evidence: Composio setup state proves one ACTIVE LinkedIn account with r_organization_admin and w_organization_social.
PR #2697 carries the structured v3.1 implementation and post-create containment.
